tables.name: deleted_instances
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE deleted_instances (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: instances
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE instances (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: maintenance_policies
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE maintenance_policies (instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES instances(id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: meta
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: operations
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE operations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, runtime BLOB,
 UNIQUE(actor, request_id))

tables.name: project_anchor_starts
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_anchor_starts (project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(id), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operations(id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_jobs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_jobs (project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(id), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operations(id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_member_launches
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_launches (instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES project_members(instance_id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operations(id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_member_readiness
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_readiness (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_members(instance_id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_member_resumed_readiness
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_resumed_readiness (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_members(instance_id), resume_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_member_resumes(operation_id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_member_resumes
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_resumes (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id),project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),instance_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES project_members(instance_id),retirement_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES project_member_retirements(operation_id),body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_member_retirements
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_retirements (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_members(instance_id), container_id TEXT NOT NULL, exit_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_member_stop_exits(operation_id), body BLOB NOT NULL, UNIQUE(instance_id,container_id))

tables.name: project_member_stop_exits
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_stop_exits (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_members(instance_id), stop_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_member_stops(operation_id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_member_stops
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_stops (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_members(instance_id), container_id TEXT NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, UNIQUE(instance_id,container_id))

tables.name: project_member_storage
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE project_member_storage (instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES project_members(instance_id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operations(id), body BLOB NOT NULL)

tables.name: project_members
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_members (
 instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
 http_port INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(http_port BETWEEN 1024 AND 65535),
 runtime_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

tables.name: projects
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE projects (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body BLOB NOT NULL)
